model_output.rationale: All four lines denied OA-18 + N111 on a Medicare Part B (MB) remit. Claim filed as CLM05-3=1 (original) but payer already holds an adjudicated claim for the same provider/member/DOS/procedures — CLP07 2623576767957 confirms adjudication. Duplicate edit is hard-coded and unappealable. Patient eligible (271 EB*1, no termination). Prior claim's disposition governs.

root_cause.explanation: Entire claim (all four lines) denied OA-18 under group OA with N111. Submitted as frequency 1 against an already-adjudicated prior claim for same provider, member, DOS 2026-07-05, and procedures (97140, 97110). Hard-coded duplicate edit fired.

next_action.detail: Check original claim disposition via Novitas portal/IVR. If original paid, post payment and close. If original was denied for a correctable reason, request a telephone reopening — never resubmit as a new original.

evidence.fact: All four SVC lines carry CAS*OA*18; CLP status 4 (denied), $0 paid; MOA N111; CLP07=2623576767957 confirms adjudication

EB*1*IND*30 active coverage with DTP*356 begin 2024-01-01, no termination — eligibility is not at issue
OA-18 true duplicate: hard-coded edit, MACs cannot override, no appeal rights; disposition is do_not_resubmit; prior claim governs (04-exact-duplicate.md)

citations.rule: True duplicate — disposition do_not_resubmit; hard-coded, unappealable; original's disposition governs
